description: This PHP script is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically related to editing currencies. It checks for admin privileges, then includes and interacts with the ListCurrency class for delete, add, update, and display operations in the currency management module.

classes.name: ListCurrency
classes.description: A class responsible for listing and managing currency records, including handling deletions, additions, updates, and generating HTML table representations.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Handles addition of new currency records.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Returns an HTML table of the current currency records.
